title: Escaping the Literature: Exploring New Scientific Ideas with Large Language Models
summary: Modern large language model research agents, commonly marketed under the label deep research, are highly capable at locating sources, verifying claims, and synthesizing existing literature into structured reports. This capability has not translated into a comparable capacity for scientific discovery. We argue that this gap has a specific, testable cause, which we call literature attracti on: the more strongly a generation process is grounded in retrieved literature, the more its outputs converge toward concepts already dominant in that literature, at the expense of novelty.
